contentPattern: One row with a single rich-text cell (bold note title paragraph, bold sub-title, body paragraph). Extra rows/cells are appended in order into the same bordered box.
usage: Bordered consumer note / disclaimer box (e.g. product-in-testing notice with a terms-of-awareness text).
reuseGuidance: Use for short legal notes, disclaimers or consumer warnings that must stand out from body text inside a thin bordered box. For long legal text without a box use default content.
